changes: Shared and private project documents with explicit CLI discovery and checks.
applies_when: A project wants document entry points.
steps: Run docs setup; retain existing files, use relative shared links and ignored private notes; run docs check.
no_change_when: Existing projects without document registration keep working.

changes: Ordinary commands execute the latest compatible stable release; project version tasks and policies removed.
configuration: Legacy echo-kit.py and echo-kit.lock.json; --task and updates apply removed.
applies_when: A project uses a generated version-pinned entry or task workflow.
steps: Read updates setup help; finish active business operations/cleanup, then migrate generated entries with backups. Preserve custom entries and historical evidence; call echo-kit directly.
no_change_when: Direct CLI users need no project version files or tasks.

changes: Dependency-aware parallel service startup, bounded by a default of four in this release.
configuration: [service_startup] concurrency and services up/restart --jobs; existing depends and prepare.
applies_when: Service startup previously relied on implicit serial order.
steps: Declare real dependencies; keep shared builds in project scripts and use --jobs 1 for diagnostics. Inspect partial failures without automatic rollback.
no_change_when: Existing explicit dependencies and project adapters remain valid.

changes: Managed Docker browsers are headed with read-only noVNC; default service concurrency covers all selected services.
configuration: browser.headless, viewer_port, auto_open; explicit concurrency limits remain; external browser.endpoint stays external.
applies_when: An old container/config lacks viewing or a project expects the old implicit concurrency limit.
steps: Read browser status and active operations. After operations finish, explicitly browser down/up to recreate an owned container. For external endpoints, inspect configuration source and adjust only within authorization; never stop or adopt the external container. Set concurrency explicitly if needed.
no_change_when: Current managed containers can be reused; explicit headless/external choices and explicit concurrency limits are preserved. An upgrade alone never migrates external browsers.

changes: guide combines current Skill, protocol and release notes; updates notes explains adaptation; browser results disclose capabilities. Docker is the recommended frontend debugging route.
configuration: No new project settings. Existing browser.endpoint is an explicit compatibility exception.
applies_when: AI uses copied Kit instructions or assumes an upgraded tool migrated its project/browser.
steps: Read guide for the relevant Skill on first session use and after execution-version changes. Use updates notes --since VERSION only when that earlier version is known. Keep project facts/team rules and replace copied generic instructions with a short CLI pointer. Inspect external capability reports before proposing authorized migration.
no_change_when: Existing documents, exports, adapters and external instances are preserved. No acknowledgement files, version locks or mandatory migration.

changes: Windows desktop tray discovers registered owned services and browser containers. Reopen an existing debugging viewer without messaging AI or restarting an experiment.
configuration: Automatic tray is off for CI, noninteractive sessions and ECHO_KIT_TRAY=0. No browser port or project configuration changes.
applies_when: Windows users want to recover a closed noVNC tab while resources are running.
steps: Start services or browser normally, or run tray start in an existing workspace. Choose the project viewer from the tray menu. tray status/stop require no workspace; stopping the tray leaves business resources intact.
no_change_when: Other platforms keep CLI/viewer links. Headless and legacy browsers have no viewer. External instances are excluded. No service daemon or boot startup is installed.
